# fileclose

Closes a filehandle.

```ttl
fileclose <file handle>
```

## Remarks

Closes the file specified by &lt;file handle&gt;.
&lt;file handle&gt; is no longer valid after this command.

## Example

```ttl
fileclose fhandle
```
